title: Trump's Plunder of Venezuela's National Wealth; Looting 65 Billion Barrels of Oil
text:
" Trump's Plunder of Venezuela's National Wealth; Looting 65 Billion Barrels of Oil"

"- Trump claims to have reached an agreement with Venezuela, which he refers to as the "greatest deal in the history of the world.""

"- The head of the American terrorist government announced that his secretaries of state and war have succeeded in ensuring Washington's access to more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuela's proven oil reserves."

"- The Financial Times newspaper, citing a US official, also reported that under this agreement, US private companies have secured a 55% share of oil production in a joint project with Venezuela."

"- This agreement includes granting US companies extraction rights to Venezuelan oil fields for a long period of 100 years.
